author: SciShow
description:
How many times can you clone a clone (and then clone THAT clone) before some kind of genetic disaster strikes? If you watch a movie like The Prestige, you might think you could do it forever. If you watch a movie like The Substance, you might think you can't even do it once. Reality, it turns out, is somewhere in the middle. But it might be a lot more than you think.

Hosted by: Savannah Geary (they/them)
